anchors.deep_push_max: 58534 LSB by player 1 late game (= 6698 u at 0.11444 scale, enemy territory)

trajectory.detail: ch=06 uplink subtype 010301 carries the local player's value (8,274 samples, ~14.7/s). Trajectory: spawn 5076 LSB (581 u) -> lane ~7839 LSB (~900 u) -> mid 32710 LSB (3743 u) at t+95s; recalls drop value to 57-2700 LSB (7-310 u); repeated base<->lane<->mid trips; final minutes show retreats to base. Consistent with a real champion game path, not an angle/input/resource.

walking_speed.detail: Per-sample |delta| mass: 63% < 500 LSB/70ms (standing+walking), mean of 50-500 LSB/70ms band ~200 LSB/70ms = 2857 LSB/s = 327 u/s at 0.11444 scale (= champion walking 330-390 u/s). Dash mode at 450-550 LSB/70ms = ~817 u/s at 0.11444 (= dash speed). The same numbers at 0.22888 scale give 654/1635 u/s — implausible for WR champions.

recall_teleports.detail: Single-sample jumps cluster at 24000-32500 LSB (recall mid->base = 2746-3719 u) and 62000-65000 LSB (enemy-base->base = 7095-7437 u). Positional teleport signature; angle would not jump by exact map-half distances.

map_anchor_saturation.detail: 99.98% of values < 32768; local player max 32710-32768 LSB = mid-lane saturation; only player 1 (26 records) exceeds 32768 (late-game deep pushes 37032-58534 LSB = 4238-6698 u). An angle would cover the full circle uniformly; a position caps at the map's longitudinal extent.

uplink_echo.detail: ch=06 010301 value equals type=07 player-0 record exactly in 13.8% of samples within 400 ms (median lag ~86 ms; highest match rate of all players -> player 0 = local client). Remaining samples differ (server-authoritative/interpolated position). Direction cross-check: ch=06 = client->server (hlen=14), type=07 = server->client (hlen=4).

per_player_distinct.detail: Cross-player exact duplicate values in the same frame: 559 of ~130k values (0.4%; 538/12858 frames). Values are per-player distinct, position-like.

candidate_rejections.angle: REJECTED — uniform [0,32768) with mid saturation (not full circle); trajectory base<->lane<->mid; recall jumps are displacements not rotations
candidate_rejections.input: REJECTED — uniform full-range distribution (joystick would hug neutral); smooth physical trajectory; server broadcasts all players' values (state, not input)
candidate_rejections.resource: REJECTED — full-range uniform, dash jumps, ffff sentinel; HP/mana/gold would be smooth and bounded

structure.window: 14-slot sliding window per frame (7 old + 7 new); consecutive frames share 6-7 slots; resent slots may carry refreshed values; underlying stream = per-player state update events (~1.4 events/player/frame)

secondary_cells.03cc: 399 cells — 03 cc [u16][player], echoes uplink subtype 0103cc events
secondary_cells.04cd: 3608 cells — 04 cd [u32][player]-like, echoes uplink subtype 0104cd events

structure.block_0e: 15 B: 0e 65 03 00 00 [6B counter] ff ff ff ff; counter = game frame x 2^32 fixed-point clock; rate 6.32e10/s = 2^32 x 14.7 fps (977 blocks)
structure.block_0d: 14 B: 0d 0c 06 XX 01 YY 09 65 ZZ 06 00 00 00 00; u24 counter +2 per frame (615830 @seq396)
structure.false_positive_records: records with player index >= 11 (1359 total) = 03 01 patterns inside 0d/0e blocks (e.g. (0x0109, 0x65) from block bytes 03 01 01 09 65) plus rare genuine extra entities
structure.pre_game_frames: seq 0-79 (pre-controllable phase) carry no 03 01 records; record stream starts at seq~80

focus_mechanism.detail: focus byte = frame's primary entity. Focus=X frames carry 8-10 of the 11 entities; X fully absent in 41.6% of frames; when present, X's record is 2.6x more likely in the NEW window half (refreshed preferentially). focus varies 0-10 across frames -> NOT the local player.
